task.goal: Turn brightness to the min value.
task.final_summary: Brightness is now at the minimum: the quick settings brightness slider reads 0 (min 0, max 65535).

steps.note: Observe current screen and open brightness settings
Open notification shade to reach brightness slider
Expand quick settings to reveal brightness slider
Drag brightness slider to far left and read value
Reopen QS panel and read slider value
Tap left end of brightness slider and read value
Drag brightness thumb from current position to far left, read slider value
Tap far-left track edge of brightness slider, read value
Tap exact left bound of slider and record value
